messages.author: f2baaf6252beabe3
messages.subject: INLA crash
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm trying to fit a spatiotemporal model to 1,874 districts (Peru), with monthly observations for 19 years (so 427,272 rows). I'm building up the model, starting with an empty model (intercept only), spatial random effect only (besag), but it crashes quickly. The outcome is binary (outbreak vs. non-outbreak month). 

I've attached the output and error message, any help would be appreciated!

Thanks,
Julianne

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA crash
parts:
I guess you run out of memory. I can run the model on our server to
check, if you like. Or, for you, run on a subset. Windows might be
harder to run on, for these larger models, due to 'lack of memory'. I
do not use or have experience with Windows to know if there is way
around or some settings to be changed.

H
